exceptions: Direct engagement substitutes actual granting/result authority where no Executive activation exists.

grounding.quote:

other admitted carriers can carry these bindings.

constraints.statement: Engagement frames organize finite specialist evaluations, not the complete Product/workspace. Routes: Executive owns basis, configuration/causal-cone inventory, conjunction/priority/promotion/disposition/checkpoint and missing-frame response; Worker/Reviewer challenge cone/configuration and perform their exact specialist evaluations; Worker owns bounded realization/self-review and candidate/transition evidence; UAT/end-to-end run through Worker with Reviewer when independent assurance is required; integration/unit follow claim ownership; Worker supplies deletion evidence and Reviewer challenges exact subjects where required; Reviewer owns required independent technical assessment/triage. conditions: A frame reports a missing material relation or other evaluation-changing gap.

making its frame larger.

that owns the material decision:

grounding.quote:
The table routes evaluation. It does not predetermine a verdict or reprice its
subject.

constraints.statement: First-diagnosis routes are provisional: coherent wrong Product→Product evaluation/intake triage; Development Product becoming authored meaning→role/composition drift; mutable Source Project frozen throughout construction→lifecycle collapse; overloaded global actor→attention/capability mismatch and refined independent activations; green local frames with unevaluated Product edge→Product Composition; child-started operations→return/decision violation; summaries replacing current authority→invalid basis/substitution; Worker blind to material violations→missing/misactivated/oversized frame or capability; Reviewer rebuilding semantics→authority bleed/reuse gap; harness owner-state reconstruction despite installed projection→rival interpreter/invalid subject; assigned upstream cause without frontier→unsupported localization; green malformed fixtures/false proof→omitted test semantics; green units with failed Product→flattened broader claim; forbidden-path output→path falsification; privileged/test-only UAT→invalid subject/path; sunny-path coverage→undeclared populations/residuals; unjustified pairwise authority/persistence/recovery/migration/historical coverage→insufficient strength/basis; successor success with obsolete consumers→unproved deletion; frozen-install mutation→invalid assurance; moving-tree/rebuilt review→invalid exact basis; flattened episodes/stores→missing translation/interaction; Worker continuation→UP-020 violation; Reviewer repair retaining verdict→UP-007 violation; Reviewer priority/block/repair/activation→decision bleed; Executive merged severity/priority/verdict/block→triage collapse; Executive semantic rewrite→proxy overreach/re-entry; repeated rival-path repair→incomplete cone/owner-capability gap; reset effort after local success→coverage/altitude/topology/evidence/capability diagnosis. conditions: The claim is that this baseline was applied to outcome G on basis B under the selected engagement configuration.
exceptions: A project-defined configuration may close against its selected STDO cut, Reference Frame Method and cited authorities without claiming this optional baseline.

grounding.quote:
The retained residual boundary cannot
silently waive a mandatory predicate.

constraints.statement: Bind required predicates/joins to applicable owners and use result conjunction; evidence reliance applies Contract application to current outcome/basis/configuration/grants in existing work evidence, with no extra pass/carrier. The profile creates no execution authority, local constitutional layer, topology, runtime or universal completeness claim. Closure groups retain adopted basis/configuration and applicability; activation/work result/grant/currentness with coordinated drift locks where applicable; required review/triage/independence; branch-specific return/priority/disposition/continuation; specialist coverage/seams; distinct testing levels; interaction populations/useful discrimination; required/forbidden paths and exact subject preservation; owner-issued subject/oracle/causal findings. conditions: Continuing work has obligations that may outlive finite actor context.

grounding.quote: They add no evaluation pass or record to the existing work.

constraints.statement: Continuing work requires a recoverable source independent of private memory under workspace/context; Work-Carrier-To-Execution selects the smallest actual-lifetime carrier. Admission/closure consume shared result algebra and conjunction at deciding boundaries, preserving performance, coverage, diagnostic precedence and actual effects without extra pass/record.
constraints.uncertainty: The shared foundational/transformation definitions are not supplied.

conditions: Authority, lifetime and completion conditions of the work are already bound.
exceptions: No independent surviving state means no durable ticket follows from persistence premises.

grounding.quote:
durable
recording, execution admission and acceptance do not follow from the same
premise.

constraints.statement: F1–F6 motivate distinct carrier decisions, with linked consumers owning policy/exceptions. Surviving facts/obligations need state outside private memory; Product locates carriers and ticket-state authority controls mutations. Admission must check exact contract/current grant, not ticket/lane/label, and does not execute or renew outcome authority. Goals/tickets/milestones/boards/comments retain separate subjects/owners; green projections or milestone acceptance cannot replace ticket truth and source divergence must be resolved before reliance. Sprint deferral changes proof time, not obligation; law changes require re-entry. Tenant proof/acceptance never transfers another tenant's lifecycle closure. Closure needs exact evidence and required decisions: rejection cannot satisfy acceptance, review events cannot replace conditions, current judgments need not repeat for actor change. Material terms require owner resolution, not familiar spelling/files. Migration closure needs authoritative replacement and old-path disposition; green wrappers/mixed proofs/downstream outcomes cannot fill missing source-carrier conditions. Ticket chooses run contracts, ordered carrier policy, durable result surfaces, state/layout, escrow/close records, tenant fields, continuity, triage and migration records; Foundations owns currentness/conjunction, Spec owns semantic/change/migration/sprint policies, Product owns location/tenant identity and applicable law selects independent review/reserved acceptance.
constraints.uncertainty: Several linked consumer policies are outside this excerpt.

conditions: Work obligations may survive an activation and continued reliance is needed.

grounding.quote:
filenames and lifecycle states do not create execution or acceptance
authority.

constraints.statement: Under F1/F3/F5/F6 and workspace/context, continued reliance needs recoverable identity, state and authority. This member chooses Goals/tickets/sprints/run contracts/smallest-carrier policy and UP-006 milestone truth; Product and ticket-state authorities bind them. Names/states create no grants. Milestone conjunction preserves scopes and does not count deferred work as delivered.

grounding.quote: A sprint may contain durable tickets, manifest-local iteration entries, or both.

constraints.statement: A sprint may contain tickets, local iterations or both. Use tickets for independent durable identity across sessions; use manifest-local iterations for small changes whose sole independent value is sprint traceability. Batch authority does not remove paydown-ticket requirements for debt surviving sprint close.

grounding.quote: execution may proceed in the same invocation under the admitted contract

constraints.statement: Tickets survive sessions/work waves; sprints survive a bounded batch/close review; execution contracts govern one run. Intended loop: work arrives, smallest lawful lifetime carrier is selected, one run contract is drafted, system validates/admit-or-rejects, execution may proceed in the same invocation only under admitted contract, closure uses that contract, and state flows through proof/gap analysis/repricing. Contracts classify work, check deterministic criteria, record admitted basis on selected durable surface and assemble prompts from admitted law rather than raw phrasing.

exceptions: Optional/deferred work requires an explicit disposition and owner.

grounding.quote: Milestone acceptance proves only its declared claim.

constraints.statement: Accepted design does not satisfy implementation, installed proof, qualification or release. Ticket completion requires every closure-bearing milestone accepted. Commentary/generated summaries cannot mutate milestone or ticket truth.

grounding.quote:
Their absence
from the project tree is not absence from the governing method.

constraints.statement: The starter layout has stdo_default.json, specification/GOALS.md, .ai-workspace/sprints/, tickets/{backlog,active,completed}/ and comments/<agent-id>/. Product Definition resolves POSTING_GUIDE and TICKET_METHOD from its exact shared installed STDO basis; absence from the project tree is not absence from governing method.

exceptions: A board may become ticket authority only through explicit Product Definition Overlay rebinding with no rival.

grounding.quote:
The definition locates these carriers but does not own
their ticket or comment content.

constraints.statement: ticketing.goals locates epic authority; optional ticketing.sprints.root locates batch/close-review layer; ticketing.tickets.lanes.backlog/.active/.completed locate ticket authority; ticketing.comments.root locates discussion/publication. stdo_default.json supplies default locations without owning content. No separate ACTIVE_TASKS.md is mandatory. A generated board is only a projection unless explicitly rebound as sole authority.

conditions: Locally deferrable proof cost motivates batching under F1/F4–F6.

grounding.quote: supplies preservation and authority, not permission to defer.

constraints.statement: Batching may change proof cadence while preserving outer obligations, but Contract application supplies no deferral permission. This family chooses manifest/admission/escrow exclusions/close review; governing domain policy decides surviving debt. Sprint status is lifecycle state; admission, closure and transition determinations return core results on their exact predicates.

exceptions: Alternative bound carriers must preserve identity, required fields, history, closure law and one-truth relation.

grounding.quote: Each sprint has one durable manifest record.

constraints.statement: Each sprint has one durable manifest, default one Markdown file. Local filenames should carry stable id and short slug; dated SPRINT-... examples are recommendations, not required naming.

conditions: Every sprint manifest.

grounding.quote: Each sprint manifest must record at least:

constraints.statement: Require id, title, status, goal, opened_at, updated_at, authority_refs, scope, excluded_boundaries, expected_change_classes, included_tickets or iterations, closure_trigger, closure_law, proof_surface, deferred_compliance, non_closure_conditions and paydown_policy. authority_refs cites governing Goals/Intent/Product/Requirement/Design or other surfaces. excluded_boundaries identifies forbidden changes, typically Product truth, data contracts, runtime semantics, governance/closure law, public carrier shape and release criteria. deferred_compliance identifies intentional local proof/review/accessibility/screenshot/walkthrough/test/design-wording/trace deferrals. paydown_policy binds close-review classifications and durable follow-up.

grounding.quote: Minimum sprint status model:

constraints.statement: Minimum states: active admits iteration inside boundary; closing freezes new iteration while review/paydown classification runs; closed means close review and classification/durable-follow-up conditions satisfied; superseded means a wrong sprint boundary was replaced by new authority, sprint or tickets. Optional planned/cancelled states do not replace close review.

conditions: Sprint admission of work.
exceptions: Manifest-local iterations may use the sprint's class only while inside scope and excluded boundaries.

grounding.quote: A sprint may admit work only when the manifest makes the boundary reviewable.

constraints.statement: Admission needs bounded scope, cited authority, expected change classes, explicit exclusions, closure law, non-closure conditions and deferred-compliance paydown policy. Sprint may batch repeated closure criteria but cannot batch away intake triage; substantive tickets still record lawful change_class and re_entry_point.

conditions: Local compliance proof is proposed for sprint escrow.

grounding.quote: Deferred compliance is not silent debt. It is escrow held by the sprint.

constraints.statement: Deferral requires named proof/cleanup class, debt local to admitted surface, expected correction cheaper than per-change proof, short enough sprint for reviewability, and mandatory close classification/paydown. Screenshots/walkthroughs, visual review, accessibility, meaningful UX replay, design wording, trace and local realization cleanup may qualify only if governing method permits. Escrow cannot hide new Product truth, changed data contracts, new runtime/governance/closure/provenance/evidence semantics, missing constructive carriers, changed public graph functions/AssetSurface contracts or law changes needing goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice or design_reframe. On discovery record the finding and exit through standalone ticket, repricing or supersession.
constraints.uncertainty: AssetSurface, public graph functions and detailed deferral policy are referenced but not defined here.

conditions: Sprint closing.
exceptions: Supported alternatives within domain obligations remain permitted; acceptance implies no preferred implementation.

grounding.quote:
the
treatment word alone cannot choose the compliance verdict.

constraints.statement: Begin by setting closing; freeze iterations, review every item against manifest, check evidence durability, walk changed surfaces against authority, classify deferred compliance and open paydown tickets for surviving debt. Each item gets one treatment: accepted=compliant; local_paydown=local debt captured in ticket; design_reframe/requirement_reprice/product_reprice=respective repricing; remove=back out or exclude from closure. Separately assess exact current compliance: all obligations including required acceptance established→satisfied, solely supporting accepted's compliance meaning; demonstrated violation/drift→falsified; insufficient proof/unresolved applicability or requirement/missing reason→indeterminate; contradictory/uninterpretable subject/basis→invalid_basis; outside scope/capability→out_of_frame. Paydown may hold defects or unproved obligations, repricing may reflect defeated claim or unresolved change, and removal may be authorized without defect. Retain causes/findings and conjunction; deferral is not proof. Each treatment also has a separate exact-item/basis/mandate decision result: supported authorized decision→satisfied; demonstrated absent/unauthorized decision→falsified; insufficient decision evidence→indeterminate with scope/basis diagnoses. Labels supply neither missing compliance nor paydown ticket/retention permission. Retain performance/absent coverage and observe completion of effects. Close only when every item/debt is classified and resulting paydown/repricing durable; surviving local debt needs governing permission, never hidden authority drift. Sprint closure may coexist with open paydown but proves neither repayment, item compliance nor unmet delivery.

exceptions: Repository/external tracker carriers are lawful only with preserved contract, history, transitions, stable identity, searchability and closure, without co-equal local copy.

grounding.quote: Each ticket has one durable authoritative record.

constraints.statement: One authoritative durable record per ticket, default one Markdown file. Local filenames should contain stable id and short slug; T-/B-/S-/C- examples are recommended naming only.

conditions: Backlog or active work genuinely has more than one tenant execution line.
exceptions: Historical completed tickets are exempt unless reopened or explicitly repriced.
Upstream-only work has no duplicate yet; single-tenant work requires no sibling.

grounding.quote: one ticket must not claim closure for more than one build-tenant lifecycle

constraints.statement: Ticket Method owns work-item/lifecycle relations within urn:stdo:bounded-context:build-tenancy, not tenant identity/realization meaning. Preserve the upstream authority ticket and one suffixed tenant-local ticket per execution line, appending a tenant mnemonic to base id/filename. Each tenant keeps independent status/proof/closure/repricing/reopening; peer green cannot hide blockers or false closure. Base ticket may remain upstream authority; backlog/active multi-tenant execution/closure lives on suffixed duplicates. Duplicates should record source_ticket and build_tenant. Any build_tenant value must identify the Product how.build_tenants entry; path/alias/tracker labels count only if the Overlay binds them as identity. T1/T2 examples are recommendations, not universal tenant identities.
constraints.uncertainty: Build-tenancy identity is owned by the unsupplied SPEC_METHOD and Product registry.

grounding.quote: Each ticket must record at least:

constraints.statement: Every ticket requires id, title, type, ticket_category, status, goal, change_intent, change_class, re_entry_point, triaged_at, created_at and updated_at. Recommended additions: priority, dependencies, links, intake_source, affected_boundary, source_ticket when derived/duplicated, build_tenant when tenant-local. implementation_migration additionally requires migration_strategy and library_usage; tenant-local migrations require build_tenant and source_ticket when derived from upstream; consume/extend library usage requires governing_library, none requires library_rationale. Runtime-drafted admission contracts should at minimum also carry target_truth, relevant superseded_truth, closure_law, evaluation_criteria, non_closure_conditions and proof_surface.

grounding.quote: Ticket category is orthogonal to ticket type.

constraints.statement: Any feature, bug, spike or chore may be ordinary or implementation_migration. Use migration for governed truth-path replacement rather than merely changing code until tests pass, including replacement of read-model/carrier families, public interfaces requiring all affected producers/consumers to migrate before closure, or removal of authoritative bridge/compatibility paths.

conditions: ticket_category is implementation_migration.
exceptions: Downstream exploration is allowed while source work is active, but is non-closure evidence until the carrier is admitted and authoritative.

grounding.quote:
a downstream ticket must not close while its upstream source-carrier ticket
  remains open

constraints.statement: Follow Spec's inside-out rule: source-carrier publication/admission tickets are upstream; prompt/projection/report/dossier/review and other consumer-hardening tickets depend on them. The dependency order is source carrier to downstream consumers, never reversed. Downstream closure is barred while the upstream source ticket is open.
constraints.uncertainty: The full Spec migration rule is not supplied.

grounding.quote: Ticket category and change class are also orthogonal.

constraints.statement: Record the intake-declared Spec class independently of record type and category. Common, non-exclusive examples pair feature with goal/intent/product/requirement repricing or design reframe; bug with requirement reprice/design reframe/realization_refactor; chore with design reframe/realization_refactor. A spike still carries current triage class and should end in a more specific downstream ticket or explicit no-further-substantive-change decision. bug + implementation_migration + design_reframe is consistent.

conditions: Intake triage and upward propagation, including bug treatment.
exceptions: An unchanged owner/layer walk is not repeated merely for a new role.

grounding.quote:
the ticket records that result and its J/O residuals instead of determining them
again from its label or Public delta.

constraints.statement: Consume Spec's computed-classification-and-treatment result for owner/layer traversal, complete relevant Public membership/value delta, accepted-design scope/trace coverage and rule-determined treatment; reference exact result/residuals. For bugs, bind requirement/design coverage and sufficiency: actual requirement insufficiency re-enters its owner; sufficient requirements with missing/insufficient design re-enter Design; sufficient requirements/design with deviating implementation select repair/rejection under realization_refactor. Actual Goal/Intent/Product changes follow their owners. The classifier distinguishes missing evidence from established insufficiency and candidate correction from changed governing meaning; ticket labels/Public deltas do not reclassify.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete classifier and J/O residual semantics are external.

conditions: Substantive work.

grounding.quote:
a ticket
for substantive work must carry the minimum metadata required by
`SPEC_METHOD.md` intake triage.

constraints.statement: Record at least declared change_intent, lawful change_class, lawful re_entry_point and triaged_at in the durable ticket work-tracking authority.

conditions: Every execution governed by Ticket Method.
exceptions: An explicit ticket-state-authority instruction selects durability but does not admit execution or widen work authority.

grounding.quote:
First establish applicable upstream work authority, then select
the first matching row.

constraints.statement: Use one run-scoped contract. Establish upstream authority then take first matching policy row; local boundary is admitted sprint, otherwise current run. No authority: admit no contract, do not create substitute-authority ticket, stop/re-enter. Exact admitted covering ticket: reuse it and derive contract, no duplicate. Authority but no covering ticket and state/obligation survives local boundary: durable ticket plus run contract, create/update only under ticket-state authority. Authority/no ticket and sprint-contained work with no post-close state: manifest plus local iteration, no durable ticket. Authority/no ticket or sprint and one-run/no surviving state: intake contract, no durable ticket. Ticket-shaped fields create neither durable identity nor lane state. Missing tickets neither require nor authorize creation. Exact Product-authorized instruction may support a one-run contract; generic request or model-widened scope cannot. Surviving-state need alone creates no ticket mutation authority.

exceptions: Draft, validate, admit and execute may occur in one invocation without separate turn/ticket/approval ceremony.

grounding.quote:
A conversation return alone is not durable

constraints.statement: Drafting and admission remain distinct; execution begins only after deterministic admission or explicit human override of the exact contract, never inferred from draft/carrier/lane/active label. Before return, surviving obligations become sprint-local entries if contained in the admitted sprint, otherwise tickets only under ticket-state authority; lacking that authority, retain in named result surface or authorized enclosing carrier, withhold closure on that gap and return re-entry. Execution and closure use the same categorization/criteria/proof/non-closure conditions, then proof/gap analysis/repricing. Every refusal retains reason. Unsupported/reasonless admitted labels are indeterminate with authenticated counterevidence/scope/basis diagnoses retained. Required evaluation without result stays an absent slot with known performance/uncertainty, not invented assessment. Drafted/superseded are carrier states. Admission differs from work performance/completion and earlier grants require currentness.
